## Summary
The team agreed to implement a phased rollout of Project Cedar, starting with 10% of accounts. The first cohort will launch on August 20. A rollback checklist has been assigned to Rowan with a completion deadline of August 18. The root cause of payment latency remains under investigation, with a potential link to PCI logging noted but not confirmed.

## Key points
- Project Cedar will move to a phased rollout, starting with 10% of accounts.
- The first cohort will begin on August 20.
- Rowan owns the rollback checklist and will complete it by August 18.
- Payment latency may be related to PCI logging, but this has not been confirmed.
- No vendor change was approved.

## Decisions
- None recorded.

## Action items
- [ ] Rowan — complete rollback checklist (due August 18)

## Notes
The cause of payment latency is still under investigation and remains an open question. No vendor change has been approved. The link between PCI logging and payment latency is speculative and requires further validation. The rollout plan is currently scoped to a 10% cohort with no further details on subsequent phases provided.
